description: Graphite drawing of a canyon the drawing is composed of five lines that represent the plateau in the foreground, the hill in the background, and three bumps that are possibly plants or rocks on the canyon floor. This artwork is on the back of *Untitled (Palo Duro Canyon*, 1916–1917 (cat no. 149).
title: Untitled (Palo Duro Canyon)
